base.description: The target branch the PR merges into (the protected main line). The seat never merges it — a human governor does, on green CI.

branch.description: The non-main feature branch the change was applied and pushed to.

commit_sha.description: The HEAD commit pushed to the branch, taken from the actual push output in this run — never fabricated.

pr_url.description: The opened pull request URL, taken from the gh/API response in this run.

pr_number.description: The opened pull request number, from the same response.

title.description: The PR title, stating what changed.
